name: Yamaha Virago 1100
engine: 1063 cc air-cooled SOHC V-twin, two carbs, shaft drive
intro: The big Virago. The starter clutch is the known weak spot. Carbs and the regulator need the usual care.

add.title: Check the starter clutch
add.instructions: Listen for grinding or a starter that spins without turning the engine. If it slips, rebuild or replace the starter clutch.
add.reason: The later Viragos use a starter clutch under the side cover that often fails.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Starter clutch
known.what: The 750 and 1100 Viragos use a starter clutch under the side cover that often fails.
